scenario_title: Scene lockout: UI refuses further execution
procedure: reset the simulator to the seed state
wait for the simulator Telnet link before setup and fault injection
let the hub read the matrix (/ws get_status), so it is in sync before the action
setup (api): request(method='POST', path='/api/profile', json={'id': 'sw_sec_auth_01_profile', 'name': 'sw_sec_auth_01_profile', 'outputs': {'1': {'input': 6}}}) -> HTTP 200
setup (api): request(method='PUT', path='/api/v2/scenes/scene_goodnight01', json={'passcode': '***', 'steps': [{'type': 'profile', 'id': 'sw_sec_auth_01_profile'}]}) -> HTTP 200
action (browser): scene_run(scene_id='scene_goodnight01', pin_lockout={'attempts': 5, 'wrong_passcode': '***', 'item_id': 'scene_goodnight01'})

open the Settings drawer on the Scenes tab (#settings/scenes)
